definitions.explanation: The intermediate stage in the life cycle of insects that undergo complete metamorphosis, between the larval and adult stages. The insect is encased in a protective covering while it transforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蛹|さなぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{蛹|さなぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{作|つく}り{変|か}えられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Inside the pupa, the body is being rebuilt.

examples.japanese: {蛹|さなぎ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}していた→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The children were observing how a beautiful butterfly emerges from its chrysalis.

notes:
The pupal stage of insects with complete metamorphosis ({完全変態|かんぜんへんたい}). During this stage, the insect's body is broken down and rebuilt into its adult form. The kanji uses the ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ radical.

LIFE CYCLE STAGES:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: egg
- ⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧: larva (caterpillar, grub, etc.)
- {蛹|さなぎ}: pupa (chrysalis, cocoon stage)
- ⟦{成虫|せいちゅう}→成虫：18745_seichuu⟧: adult insect (imago)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛹|さなぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to pupate, to enter the pupal stage
- {蛹|さなぎ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to emerge (as an adult insect) from the pupa
- {蛹|さなぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: pupal period

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{繭|まゆ}→繭：13861_mayu⟧: cocoon — the silk casing spun by silkworms and some moth larvae; not all pupae form cocoons
- ⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧: eclosion, emergence — the process of an adult insect emerging from the pupa
